meta.name: ultrawork
meta.description: Binding ultrawork mode directive for omo-senpi. When a prompt contains ultrawork or ulw, the omo input hook injects the full directive as a hidden custom message (customType omo-ultrawork:directive, display false) ahead of the user's text, which is left untouched; a prompt queued while the agent is streaming instead carries the directive appended inside that same message. The directive is present in the conversation context; on the idle path it is not shown in the visible prompt, while a queued prompt carries the directive visibly (exactly as before this change). When the directive is already present in the conversation, do not read this file again - this file is that same directive. Read this file only when ultrawork mode is requested and the directive is not already present in the conversation.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 输入一个口令，瞬间唤醒智能体的全力模式
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你经常需要让智能体集中火力完成高难度任务。
copy.tagline_en: Enter a trigger phrase to switch the agent into deep-work mode.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often ask your agent to handle tough jobs and want a quick way to maximize its effort.

howto.what: 装上后,当你说出“ultrawork”或“ulw”,系统会在你消息前悄悄塞入一份严格的工作指令:先登记目标、写详细计划、用测试证明做完,并要求展示证据。你的原话原样保留,不会被改动。
howto.when: 当你的输入里带“ultrawork”或“ulw”时触发;若回复期间又排队了一条消息,指令会附在那条消息里。

say.text: 用 ultrawork 模式修这个登录报错
say.note: 会先建目标、写测试再改代码。

say.text: 进入 ultrawork,先写失败测试再实现
say.note: 系统先注入指令,按测试驱动流程走。

say.text: ulw 模式:给这个接口补上失败用例
say.note: 触发指令,要求先证明失败再修。

howto.what_en: After install, when you say "ultrawork" or "ulw", the system injects a strict work directive before your message: register a goal, write a detailed plan, prove completion with tests, and show evidence. Your original text is kept unchanged.
howto.when_en: Triggers when your input contains "ultrawork" or "ulw"; if a prompt is queued during streaming, the directive is appended inside that message.

say_en.text: Use ultrawork mode to fix this login error.
say_en.note: It will set a goal, write tests, then change code.

say_en.text: Enter ultrawork: write a failing test first.
ulw mode: add a failing case for this endpoint.
say_en.note: Triggers the directive to prove failure first.
